product_family: Pitch: cloud presentation/slide-design workspace with Free, Plus, Team, and Business tiers, plus an AI feature (Pitch Agent) that generates on-brand slides from prompts. A public API is announced but not yet released (waitlist only at time of review).

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type I/II)
certifications.proof_quote: no public evidence: Pitch's own Security Policy page (pitch.com/security-policy) describes TLS, AES-256 encryption, AWS hosting, and backup practices but makes no mention of a SOC 2 report or audit

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: no public evidence: not referenced on pitch.com/security-policy, pitch.com/gdpr, pitch.com/privacy-policy, or pitch.com/dpa

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI governance)
certifications.proof_quote: no public evidence: no AI-governance certification mentioned anywhere on pitch.com's security, privacy, or DPA pages, despite Pitch actively marketing AI features (Pitch Agent)

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: no public evidence: not referenced on any vendor-domain legal/security page reviewed

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: no public evidence: not referenced on any vendor-domain legal/security page reviewed; payment processing is not described as in-house

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: no public evidence: not referenced on any vendor-domain page; Pitch's hosting is described only as 'Amazon AWS, hosted in European regions' with no FedRAMP-relevant government cloud claim

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: no public evidence: not referenced on any vendor-domain page reviewed

certifications.name: GDPR (compliance posture)
certifications.proof_quote: "We are committed to follow and implement all the guidelines and recommendations from GDPR with regards to all the data and information we handle, process, and store." Pitch also names a Data Protection Officer (dpo@pitch.com), a Data Protection Handbook, staff GDPR training, and a pre-signed DPA with a documented sub-processor list.

privacy.ai_training_note: Pitch's privacy policy confirms it uses 'tools based on large language models such as generative pre-trained transformer models ("GPT") that may be used for presentation generation, automatically annotating slide data, and converting images,' with the DPA's sub-processor list naming OpenAI OpCo LLC and Anthropic PBC as AI/ML sub-processors. Neither the privacy policy, GDPR page, nor DPA explicitly states whether customer presentation content is used to train underlying models, and no opt-out toggle or setting is documented on any public vendor page reviewed.
privacy.data_region: Primary hosting in AWS eu-west-1 (Ireland) per the Security Policy and GDPR pages; the Privacy Policy separately states some processing occurs via 'service providers in the United States' under EU Standard Contractual Clauses, which is not fully reconciled with the EU-only hosting claim.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: All communications with Pitch servers use TLS; the domain is on the HSTS Preload list to force HTTPS.

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: AWS AuroraDB and S3 configured with AES-256 encryption for all data at rest.

security.name: Data hosting region
security.value: Amazon Web Services, servers located in Ireland (eu-west-1 region).

security.name: Backups
security.value: Daily database backups retained up to 30 days, with regular recovery-exercise testing.

security.name: Vulnerability testing
security.value: Semi-automated scanning (e.g. Burp Suite) run against new features.

security.name: Authentication
security.value: Password/auth handling delegated to Auth0; Google OAuth sign-in is 'verified and trusted by Google.'

security.name: Sub-processor transparency
security.value: 13 named sub-processors disclosed (incl. AWS, Auth0, SendGrid/Twilio, WorkOS, OpenAI, Anthropic, fal, Algolia, MagicBell, Pusher, Mux, Imgix) with a 14-day change-notification process.

products.name: Pitch Free
products.data_scope: User account profile, presentation content, usage data in the shared cloud workspace.
products.notes: Unlimited presentations on the free tier; same infrastructure/security posture as paid tiers.

products.name: Pitch Plus / Team / Business
products.data_scope: Same data categories as Free, plus brand libraries, shared templates, viewer/engagement analytics on shared decks, and (Business) custom deal rooms.
products.notes: Pricing scales by seat count and plan; no distinct security tier disclosed for Business vs lower tiers on public pages.

products.name: Pitch Agent (AI slide generation)
products.data_scope: User prompts and possibly presentation/brand content are processed by GPT-based models via third-party sub-processors (OpenAI, Anthropic).
products.notes: Whether this content is retained or used for model training is not publicly documented; treat as an open question, not a confirmed no.

products.name: Pitch API
products.data_scope: Not yet available - homepage lists it as 'API coming soon' with an interest waitlist.
products.notes: Not available yet, so there is no current security posture to assess.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium with paid Plus/Team/Business seat-based subscription tiers (monthly or annual billing).
compare.data_residency: EU (Ireland, AWS eu-west-1) per vendor's security/GDPR pages, with some sub-processor data flows (including US-based AI providers) under Standard Contractual Clauses.

flags: A third-party aggregator, Nudge Security (security-profiles.nudgesecurity.com, not a vendor page), lists Pitch as 'SOC 2, PCI, HIPAA, GDPR, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, and CSA STAR Level 1 Compliant' with no supporting evidence, citation, or methodology disclosed. This contradicts Pitch's own Security Policy, Privacy Policy, GDPR, and DPA pages, none of which mention any of these certifications.
AI training posture on customer data is not publicly confirmed or denied by the vendor despite active AI feature marketing (Pitch Agent) and OpenAI/Anthropic being disclosed sub-processors.

Minor data-region inconsistency between the Security Policy/GDPR page (EU-only, Ireland) and the Privacy Policy (references US-based service providers under SCCs) - not necessarily wrong, but not reconciled in vendor copy.
Public API is pre-launch ('coming soon'), so no API-specific security/data-handling terms exist yet to assess.
